ensemble.definition: shared simulateRun plan (38 s ride, 20 s rest, 33 s ride, lift-approach stop; final hold 30 s so the stow completes) × FULLRUN_CASES_R4 (calm + 3/6/9 m/s × head/tail/crossL/crossR × 3 seeds + tail 3.5/4.5/5.5 × 3 seeds). Round-4 shared rules: avail on footage().bodyPx ≥300 px over col.riding (never-launched runs 0), artefact = overlap AND ≥2 px width; jitter = p90 over flown cases of footageStability(R).subjectRms; headClear to helmetAt (bodyPoints head) incl. the leash, capture window ≤3 s excluded; setup/ops p90; KE/force max; gates on windEstimate().

availBound.note: avail mean over 48 = Σ case avail / 48; gated (never-launched) cases count 0. Even if every case incl. tail 9 m/s flew at the launched mean the ensemble would only reach the launched mean.

tailSweep.note: off-grid true tailwind 2–6 m/s (0.5 steps) × seeds 11–16, intensity 0.15 (<6 m/s). gateOn = defaults (gate 3.0 m/s on the shared estimate, i.e. the realistic gate errors of the ±1 m/s bias); gateOff = forced launch (what the gate protects against); gate45 = the round-3 4.5 m/s gate.

stages.en: Standing at the top: the 132 g folded glider sits in an 80 mm hard holster behind the seat (swivel clamp on the belt, turned aside on the chairlift) (wings swung aft and folded at 55 % chord); a 0.35 m orange glass-fibre line-guide wand on the holster mouth carries the leash exit; reel, 15 Wh pack and 48 V boost on the belt. One tap arms it; the belt checks the tailwind gate from its wind estimate.

Push-off: the glider slides out of the holster mouth onto the snow and its wings spring open; after 4.5 m of line it is sled-towed and winch-launched; footage counts from 0.8 m. Ejection and wing-deploy hardware are illustrative.

Carved turns: the glider flies on slope gravity, copying the hip’s line at ≈6 m; the leash powers it and adds only the drag shortfall. A closed-loop 3-servo mount keeps the 50° lens on the rider; gyro stabilisation and reframing are done after the run.
Rest stop: the glider zooms up and side-steps behind the stopped rider while still filming, then deep-stall “parachutes” onto the snow, folds and is drawn to a 3 m park.
Push off again: the parked glider opens its wings, is sled-towed and winch-launched — no button.
Following again; the station moves to rear-right.
Stop inside the lift-base geofence: the glider drops and folds; the reel pulls it over the snow into the holster (capture hardware pending tests).
